entities.name: Torian Sha
entities.description: A soul warden who once cursed the angels and now spends his gift of time in devotion to them.

entities.name: Urien of the Lightwielders
entities.description: A Lightwielder who sees clearly the error of others' ways.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who teaches that conviction sharpens the blade and rage must be turned on enemies.

entities.name: Grakk
entities.description: A creature who feels warm and fuzzy for the first time in his life.

entities.name: Lord Hilneth
entities.description: A lord who admires an armorsmith's suit and fears morning fog.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who speaks on consciousness, illusion and mind control.

entities.name: Garild
entities.description: A merfolk mage who scrambles brains and gives wondrous dreams.

entities.name: Doriel
entities.description: A mentor of Mistral Isle teaching that the key to a puzzle is within.

entities.name: Saldrath
entities.description: A master artificer who is one masterpiece from ruling the world and claims his masterpiece is complete.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: A Rimewind master who tells victims their downfall was warm blood.

entities.name: Scytha
entities.description: An aeromage whose army rides horses made to fly.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A student who finds telepathy disappointing.

entities.name: Ambassador Laquatus
entities.description: An ambassador who says the educated mind will collapse under its own weight.

entities.name: Lumi
entities.description: A goatherd who welcomes a wall of frost clearing the pasture.

entities.name: Yurin
entities.description: A royal assassin who says wars are won by a single artfully placed blade.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who commands the dead.

entities.name: Vradeen
entities.description: A vampire nocturnus who speaks of blood and stress.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A shapeshifting tyrant who praises mental attacks.

entities.name: Keren-Dur
entities.description: A necromancer lord who orders his minions to kill a giant sent by Phirax.

entities.name: Phirax of Blood Ridge
entities.description: A figure of Blood Ridge who sent a war giant against Keren-Dur.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: Author of the Necromancer's Handbook.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who says rage yearns to betray its rational prison.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who guards a monastery with an inferno elemental.

entities.name: Taivang
entities.description: A barbarian warlord who chooses a jackal familiar as his reflection.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A pit fighter who likes a double-edged sword.

entities.name: Kezim
entities.description: A prodigal pyromancer who comments on panic and mountains.

entities.name: Jariad
entities.description: A scholar who burned down his laboratory.

entities.name: Borzard
entities.description: An exterminator captain who advises killing ant queens first.

entities.name: Kivi
entities.description: A thornberry harvester who watched bramble creepers tear a baloth to ribbons.

entities.name: Ramal
entities.description: A sage who admires the freedom of centaurs.

entities.name: Alera Benath
entities.description: A Kalonian ranger who warns against firing on the behemoth.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A wild planeswalker who says some jungle creatures cannot be hunted.

entities.name: Dionus
entities.description: An elvish archdruid who speaks on oaks, unicorns and interlopers.

entities.name: Soron
entities.description: A rhox pikemaster who wonders if weapons and armor are a step backward.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who tells of a wise woman and her book.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The source from which the world and its elves grew, in elvish teaching.

entities.name: Lightwielders
entities.description: A faction that wields light and judges error.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: An organization that hired a zombie to work at its cemetery.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Mountains ruled by the Shivan dragon.

entities.name: Blood Ridge
entities.description: Home of the Berserkers of Blood Ridge and the war giant.

entities.name: Keldon
entities.description: Warriors who need signals to tell them when to stop.

events.summary: Torian Sha recalls cursing the angels until they rewarded his scorn with the gift of time, which he has spent in devotion.
events.quote: Until that day I cursed the angels, those uncaring lights in the sky.

events.summary: Torian Sha explains the law prohibits capital punishment so offenders can redeem themselves.
events.quote: Our law prohibits capital punishment.

events.summary: Ajani Goldmane teaches that one's blade is only as sharp as one's conviction.
events.quote: One's blade is only as sharp as one's conviction.

events.summary: Grakk, pacified, feels warm and fuzzy for the first time.
events.quote: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

events.summary: Lord Hilneth praises an armorsmith's suit but wishes for mail for all his people.
events.quote: This is a fine suit, armorsmith.

events.summary: Saldrath claims he is one masterpiece from ruling the world.
events.quote: I'm one masterpiece away from ruling this pathetic world.

events.summary: Jace Beleren says all consciousness is one, separated by a thin veil of the physical.
events.quote: All consciousness is one, separated only by a thin veil of the physical.

events.summary: Jace Beleren asks why fight the body when the mind that rules it can be dominated.
events.quote: Why fight the body when you can dominate the mind that rules it?

events.summary: Scytha boasts that humanity envied flight, so they took it.
events.quote: Humanity has always envied the power of flight. So we took it.

events.summary: Teferi, a fourth-level student, finds telepathy reveals how boring people are.
events.quote: The most disappointing thing about learning telepathy is finding out how boring people really are.

events.summary: Yurin declares wars are won with a single artfully placed blade.
events.quote: This is how wars are won

events.summary: Liliana Vess tells a raised servant it can rest when dead.
events.quote: Stop complaining. You can rest when you're dead.

events.summary: Liliana Vess tells a victim she will not take all their secrets, just their most precious one.
events.quote: I'm not going to deprive you of all your secrets.

events.summary: Volrath praises mental attacks as victims never remember them.
events.quote: The beauty of mental attacks is that your victims never remember them.

events.summary: Liliana Vess insists death is no excuse for disobedience.
events.quote: Death is no excuse for disobedience.

events.summary: Keren-Dur orders his minions to kill a war giant Phirax sent, scoop its skull and drive it back.
events.quote: Phirax of Blood Ridge has sent a war giant at us?

events.summary: Sarkhan Vol says rage yearns to betray its rational prison.
events.quote: Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison.

events.summary: Jariad burns through scrolls and then burns down his laboratory.
events.quote: Jariad burned the midnight oil, burned through scroll after scroll, and then burned down his laboratory.

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar warns invaders of her monastery to take it up with her inferno elemental.
events.quote: Those who wish to invade our monastery, please take it up with my servant.

events.summary: Taivang chooses a jackal as a familiar to reflect his bloodthirst.
events.quote: My familiar will be a reflection of me

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar asks who would want to ignite things one at a time.
events.quote: Who'd want to ignite things one at a time?

events.summary: Kamahl jokes that a double-edged sword is just a sword with two edges.
events.quote: It's a sword. With two edges.

events.summary: Kivi saw fully grown bramble creepers tear a baloth to ribbons in seconds.
events.quote: I've seen the fully grown ones tear a baloth to gory ribbons in seconds.

events.summary: Garruk Wildspeaker admits some jungle creatures simply cannot be hunted.
events.quote: There are some things in the jungle that simply can't be hunted.

events.summary: Dionus explains the desire for a unicorn's horn drives all who see it to kill.
events.quote: The desire for its magic horn inspires such bloodthirsty greed

events.summary: Saldrath declares his masterpiece complete.
events.quote: My masterpiece is complete

events.summary: Karn tells of a wise woman who wrote everything she learned in a book, and began again in white ink.
events.quote: Everything the wise woman learned she wrote in a book
